title: Development and Analysis of Image Fusion Techniques for Satellite Images
description: Research on combining complementary satellite image sources to improve spatial, spectral and semantic interpretability for downstream remote sensing analysis.
impact: Improves interpretability of satellite imagery for Earth observation and space applications.
expectedOutcomes: Validated fusion algorithms, comparative studies, datasets or reproducible pipelines, and publications.

title: Object-Based High Resolution Optical Image Analysis for Landslide and LULC Classification
description: Object-based image analysis for high-resolution optical imagery, with emphasis on landslide mapping and land-use/land-cover classification.
collaborators: Dr. Tapas R Martha, NRSC Hyderabad; Dr. Ramarao, IIST
impact: Supports disaster assessment, environmental monitoring and geospatial decision support.
expectedOutcomes: Classification workflows, validation reports, research papers and deployable analysis methods.

title: Developing a Virtual Reality Model for Disaster Simulation
description: Immersive simulation model for disaster scenarios, enabling spatial reasoning, visualization, training and communication.
impact: Creates safer and repeatable environments for disaster preparedness and training.
expectedOutcomes: VR prototype, interaction studies, scenario library and publications.
